'''Darth Vilus's fourth apprentice''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. He was killed by his [[Darth Vilus|master]] after being caught spying on him.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Vilus's fourth apprentice is mentioned briefly in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
